The '''''Joyous Roamer''''' was an [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Spacetug/Legends|tug]] under the command of [[Omad Kaeg]] that had been built sometime before [[45 ABY]]. It was used in the [[Chiloon Rift/Legends|Chiloon Rift]].<ref name="Crucible" />
